reason: Provides multi-layer A-share and other stock investment research using public market data, heuristic scoring, risk analysis, institutional consensus, valuation, comparisons, and report generation.

summaries.zh: 通过公开市场数据提供股票行情、价值评分、风险扫描、机构共识、估值和对比报告等量化投研功能。
summaries.en: Provides quantitative stock research with public market data, including quotes, value scoring, risk scanning, institutional consensus, valuation, comparisons, and report generation.

capabilities: retrieves public market and financial data from external APIs
calculates heuristic value, risk, consensus, technical, comparison, and DCF metrics
generates structured and Markdown investment research reports
provides command-line and model-callable research tools
